objective: Definir contrato puro de dominio Cavas que separe contrato celebrado, estado de pago y activacion de beneficios. No DDL, no persistencia financiera paralela, no proveedor POS/ERP hardcodeado. El porcentaje de activacion debe venir de politica configurable y puede ser menor a 100. La activacion tambien depende del estado contractual y documental. Excepciones deben ser explicitas y auditables; nunca deben falsificar porcentaje pagado.

import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    CavaActivationException,
    CavaActivationPolicy,
    CavaBenefitStatus,
    CavaContractFinancialState,
    CavaContractStatus,
    CavaPaymentStatus,
    paid_ratio,
    payment_status,
    resolve_benefit_status,
)


def _state(**kwargs):
    data = dict(
        contract_id="CON-1", contract_status=CavaContractStatus.VIGENTE,
        amount_due=1000.0, amount_paid=0.0, dossier_complete=True, contract_accepted=True,
    )
    data.update(kwargs)
    return CavaContractFinancialState(**data)


def test_contract_payment_and_benefit_are_separate_states():
    state = _state(amount_paid=500.0)
    assert payment_status(state) == CavaPaymentStatus.PARCIAL
    assert resolve_benefit_status(state, CavaActivationPolicy(minimum_paid_ratio=0.5)) == CavaBenefitStatus.ACTIVO


def test_activation_threshold_is_policy_not_hardcoded_to_full_payment():
    state = _state(amount_paid=300.0)
    assert paid_ratio(state) == 0.3
    assert resolve_benefit_status(state, CavaActivationPolicy(minimum_paid_ratio=0.3)) == CavaBenefitStatus.ACTIVO
    assert resolve_benefit_status(state, CavaActivationPolicy(minimum_paid_ratio=0.5)) == CavaBenefitStatus.PENDIENTE


def test_payment_never_implies_activation_if_documents_or_contract_missing():
    state = _state(amount_paid=1000.0, dossier_complete=False)
    assert payment_status(state) == CavaPaymentStatus.CUBIERTO
    assert resolve_benefit_status(state, CavaActivationPolicy(minimum_paid_ratio=1.0)) == CavaBenefitStatus.PENDIENTE


def test_exception_is_audited_and_does_not_change_paid_ratio():
    state = _state(amount_paid=100.0, dossier_complete=False)
    exc = CavaActivationException(authorization_reference="AUTH-1", authorized_by_user_id="USR-1", reason="Autorizacion Direccion")
    before = paid_ratio(state)
    assert resolve_benefit_status(state, CavaActivationPolicy(minimum_paid_ratio=0.5), exc) == CavaBenefitStatus.RESTRINGIDO
    assert paid_ratio(state) == before == 0.1


def test_blocked_or_expired_contract_cannot_be_activated_by_exception():
    exc = CavaActivationException(authorization_reference="AUTH-1", authorized_by_user_id="USR-1", reason="Excepcion")
    state = _state(contract_status=CavaContractStatus.BLOQUEADO, amount_paid=1000.0)
    assert resolve_benefit_status(state, CavaActivationPolicy(minimum_paid_ratio=0), exc) == CavaBenefitStatus.BLOQUEADO


def test_policy_ratio_must_be_valid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        resolve_benefit_status(_state(), CavaActivationPolicy(minimum_paid_ratio=1.1))
